title: launch_bundle_manifest_v1
description: S2.4 §8.1 content identity #4: canonical manifest binding {runtime_content_digest, base_runtime_tree_digest, application_bundle_digest, application_source_head, launcher_config_digest, launch_tree_digest, target_platform}. launch_tree_digest independently hashes the sorted materialized launch-tree {path, type, mode, sha256} walk plus the in-tree ELF loader closure of a caller-provided tree (agent_governance_s2_4_render.launch_tree_walk_digest; tmp-dir tests only, no production path contact); a launch tree whose loader closure escapes it is a typed refusal. application_bundle_digest is never accepted as an unrelated well-formed digest: the builder recomputes §8.1 identity #3 over the caller-provided MATERIALIZED application root and refuses unless it equals the supplied digest, and application_source_head is taken from that verified package. self_digest IS launch_bundle_digest; its 64-hex leaf names the immutable launch tree /opt/arcane-equilibrium/aiml/launches/<64-hex> consumed by ml_training.alr_application_identity.verify_launch_prefix (the W2b leaf-name contract). self_digest is integrity evidence only and never a runtime/production claim.
